Class BoardAnimator

java.lang.Object
com.tetris.ui.BoardAnimator
public class BoardAnimator extends Object
Handles purely visual animations and special effects for the game board.

This class is responsible for adding "juice" or "game feel" to the UI, including:

  • Screen shake on hard drops.
  • Pulsing effects for the title logo.
  • Particle explosions when lines are cleared.
It operates on JavaFX Nodes but does not affect the game logic or state.
Author:
Jacob Villegas

  • Method Details

    • shake

      public void shake(javafx.scene.Node node)
      Applies a short, rapid horizontal shake effect to a UI element.

      Used when a piece is "hard dropped" to give the sensation of impact. The node is translated 5px to the right and back repeatedly over 50ms.

      Parameters:
      node - The JavaFX Node (usually the main game grid) to shake.

    • spawnClearParticles

      public void spawnClearParticles(javafx.scene.layout.Pane parent, List<Integer> rowIndices, List<int[]> rowData)
      Spawns "crumbling" particle debris for cleared rows.

      This method reads the color data of the cleared rows and spawns small squares at the exact screen coordinates where the blocks used to be. These particles then fall and fade out.

      Parameters:
      parent - The parent Pane where particles will be added (usually the game group).
      rowIndices - The logical indices of the rows being removed (0-24).
      rowData - The raw integer color codes for the blocks in those rows.

    • animateDebris

      private void animateDebris(javafx.scene.layout.Pane parent, javafx.scene.shape.Rectangle p)
      Helper: Applies physics-like movement to a single particle.

      The particle falls (gravity), spreads horizontally, rotates randomly, and fades out simultaneously. Once the animation finishes, the particle is removed from the scene graph to prevent memory leaks.

      Parameters:
      parent - The pane containing the particle.
      p - The particle rectangle to animate.
